svg.aria-label: Naturalisation is two articles, not one
svg.text: Naturalisation is two articles, not one
Legal age, no conviction in the last decade, no pending expulsion, the period, the title
Sufficient Greek; history, geography, culture and customs; economic and social integration
The examination sits in article 5Α, and it names no CEFR level. The B1 in circulation comes from below the statute.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 8 September 2026
